TITLE:
Kawayu Onsen Beautiful Back

IDENTITY LOCK:
None.

STYLE:
Ultra-realistic photorealism.
Authentic handheld iPhone 16 Pro photography.
Casual Instagram-style travel photo.
Natural HDR with minimal retouching.
Authentic skin texture.

SUBJECT:
Beautiful Japanese woman in her early 20s.
Long dark brown hair tied in a loose low bun with soft see-through bangs.
Large dark brown eyes.
Natural makeup.
Healthy fair skin.

BODY:
Slender feminine hourglass figure.
Slim waist.
Natural feminine curves.
Realistic anatomy.
Visible natural shoulder blades and subtle spine line.

OUTFIT:
Simple white bath towel held securely across the front of her body only.
Her entire back from shoulders to waist remains naturally uncovered.

SCENE / ENVIRONMENT:
Outdoor riverside hot spring inspired by Kawayu Onsen, Japan.
Natural stone bath beside a flowing mountain river.
Forested mountains, river rocks, and traditional Japanese inns in the background.
Subtle hot-spring steam.

POSE / EXPRESSION:
Sitting naturally in the hot spring with her back toward the camera.
Upper body gently twisted as she looks back over her shoulder.
Shoulders slightly angled to create a graceful natural S-curve through her back and waist.
The smooth curve from shoulder blades to the narrow waist is clearly visible.
Holding the towel naturally against the front of her body with both hands.
Warm, cheerful smile.

CAMERA:
Vertical 3:4 composition.
Camera positioned behind and slightly to one side.
Medium-full framing from head to submerged thighs.
Natural smartphone perspective.

LIGHTING:
Soft natural daylight.

DETAILS:
Realistic water ripples and reflections.
Natural wet skin texture.
Calm Japanese onsen atmosphere.

NEGATIVE / CONSTRAINTS:
No CGI.
No illustration.
No anime.
No plastic skin.
No towel covering the back.
No towel wrapped around the torso.
No exaggerated back arch.
No exaggerated body proportions.
No malformed anatomy or extra limbs.
No text or watermark.
